role: Matched tracepoints: Trace.t(label, values...) writes one line per call (doubles and floats as raw hex bits, integers decimal, booleans 0/1) to the file given by Main's --trace PATH, with pause/resume/restart so a trace holds only the work being compared; csrc/engine/trace.c writes the same lines from the same call sites so a diff names the first diverging step.
used_by: Probes that call Trace.t or Trace.restart: VillageProbe, SpawnProbe, PotionProbe, HostileProbe, SlimeProbe, AnimalProbe
notes: Off unless --trace is given (t() returns at once). Autoflush per line because Oracle.finish ends with Runtime.halt. grep for Trace.t( in oracle/src found no vanilla call site in this tree; the tracepoints live in the harness probes. Global static mutable writer, oracle side only.
